A common U.S. pathway is: training foundation → Private Pilot → Instrument Rating → Commercial Pilot → multiengine training → a lawful time-building route → ATP eligibility and ATP-CTP when applicable → airline selection and type-specific training. This is a planning map, not a promise that every pilot follows the same route. Review it with instructors and mentors, and verify current FAA and employer requirements before making decisions.

Revisit every few months:
• Is the current training pace sustainable?
• Which next certificate, rating, or job best supports the long-term goal?
• Are there gaps in knowledge, judgment, professionalism, or recordkeeping?
• Is the medical and financial plan still realistic?
• What hiring assumptions need to be checked against current employer information?
• Which decisions are reversible, and which deserve a second opinion?

Personal preparation prompt:
• Confirm the lesson time, location, instructor, and school instructions.
• Review the assigned material and write down questions.
• Bring the documents and equipment your instructor requires.
• Check sleep, food, hydration, medication, stress, and readiness honestly.
• Review weather and aircraft information only within your current training and instructor guidance.
• Know the lesson objective and what success should look like.

This does not replace an instructor, school checklist, preflight inspection, POH/AFM, or regulation.

Capture the lesson while it is fresh:
• What was today's mission?
• What did we practice?
• What went well, and why?
• What was difficult, and when did it begin?
• What exact feedback did the instructor give?
• What should I review before the next lesson?
• What question should I ask next time?
• What is the single best next action?

Use the Flight Log & Journal for the personal answers.

Useful interview prompts:
• Who will be the primary instructor, and how consistent is scheduling?
• What is included in the quoted price, and what commonly costs extra?
• How are weather cancellations, maintenance, and instructor changes handled?
• What aircraft availability and maintenance history should a student understand?
• How does the school track syllabus progress and stage checks?
• Which training route fits an airline-career goal, and why?
• Can current students and recent graduates describe their experience?

Record answers and compare schools on the same criteria.

Keep authoritative originals in their proper place and maintain secure copies where appropriate:
• Pilot and medical certificates
• Government identification and eligibility documents
• Logbooks and digital-logbook exports
• Instructor endorsements
• Knowledge-test and practical-test records
• School graduation or course records
• Employment and training history
• Résumé and application history

This app is an organizer, not an FAA-compliant substitute for required certificates, records, endorsements, or logbooks.

Use official sources for requirements and current editions:

Become a Pilot — https://www.faa.gov/pilots/become
Airman Certification Standards — https://www.faa.gov/training_testing/testing/acs
ATP training and certification resources — https://www.faa.gov/pilots/training/atp
Current 14 CFR Part 61 — https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-14/chapter-I/subchapter-D/part-61
FAA handbooks and manuals — https://www.faa.gov/regulations_policies/handbooks_manuals/aviation

Requirements and publications change. Her instructor, examiner, school, FAA sources, and aircraft documents take priority over this app.

CREATE TABLE material_split_lineage (
  material_id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES study_materials(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  parent_material_id     TEXT REFERENCES study_materials(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  root_material_id       TEXT REFERENCES study_materials(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  source_page_start      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (TYPEOF(source_page_start) = 'integer' AND source_page_start >= 1),
  source_page_end        INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (TYPEOF(source_page_end) = 'integer' AND source_page_end >= source_page_start),
  parent_page_start      INTEGER CHECK (parent_page_start IS NULL OR (TYPEOF(parent_page_start) = 'integer' AND parent_page_start >= 1)),
  parent_page_end        INTEGER CHECK (parent_page_end IS NULL OR (TYPEOF(parent_page_end) = 'integer' AND parent_page_end >= parent_page_start)),
  child_page_count       INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (TYPEOF(child_page_count) = 'integer' AND child_page_count >= 1),
  source_file_name       TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_title           TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_content_sha256  TEXT,
  source_total_pages     INTEGER CHECK (source_total_pages IS NULL OR (TYPEOF(source_total_pages) = 'integer' AND source_total_pages >= source_page_end)),
  parent_file_name       TEXT,
  parent_title           TEXT,
  parent_content_sha256  TEXT,
  parent_total_pages     INTEGER CHECK (parent_total_pages IS NULL OR (TYPEOF(parent_total_pages) = 'integer' AND (parent_page_end IS NULL OR parent_total_pages >= parent_page_end))),
  nested_level           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (TYPEOF(nested_level) = 'integer' AND nested_level >= 1),
  created_at             TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK (material_id != parent_material_id),
  CHECK (material_id != root_material_id),
  CHECK (child_page_count = (source_page_end - source_page_start + 1)),
  CHECK (parent_page_start IS NULL OR child_page_count = (parent_page_end - parent_page_start + 1)),
  CHECK ((parent_page_start IS NULL AND parent_page_end IS NULL) OR (parent_page_start IS NOT NULL AND parent_page_end IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK (
    (nested_level = 1 AND parent_page_start IS NULL AND parent_page_end IS NULL AND parent_total_pages IS NULL)
    OR
    (nested_level > 1 AND parent_page_start IS NOT NULL AND parent_page_end IS NOT NULL AND parent_total_pages IS NOT NULL)
  )
)

  attribution          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (attribution IN ('self_report', 'instructor_transcribed')),
  instructor_name      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(instructor_name) <= 120),
  linked_action_id     TEXT,
  linked_action_title  TEXT CHECK (linked_action_title IS NULL OR length(linked_action_title) <= 200),
  addressed_at         TEXT,
  operation_id         TEXT NOT NULL,
  recorded_at          TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (observation_id, revision),
  CHECK ((revision = 1) = (change_kind = 'created')),
  CHECK (attribution = 'instructor_transcribed' OR instructor_name = ''),
  CHECK ((linked_action_id IS NULL) = (linked_action_title IS NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE skill_observations (
  id                    TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  skill_id              TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skill_catalog_entries(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  skill_label_snapshot  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(skill_label_snapshot) <= 80),
  journal_id            TEXT REFERENCES journal_entries(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  source_journal_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_journal_date   TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_journal_title  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_journal_title) <= 200),
  source_field          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_field IN ('instructor_feedback', 'went_well', 'was_difficult', 'practiced', 'none')),
  source_text_sha256    TEXT CHECK (source_text_sha256 IS NULL OR (length(source_text_sha256) = 64 AND source_text_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
  attribution           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (attribution IN ('self_report', 'instructor_transcribed')),
  instructor_name       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(instructor_name) <= 120),
  wording               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(wording)) >= 1 AND length(wording) <= 2000 AND length(CAST(wording AS BLOB)) <= 8000),
  observed_on           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (date(observed_on) IS observed_on),
  revision              INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (TYPEOF(revision) = 'integer' AND revision >= 1),
  action_id             TEXT REFERENCES next_actions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  linked_action_id      TEXT,
  linked_action_title   TEXT CHECK (linked_action_title IS NULL OR length(linked_action_title) <= 200),
  addressed_at          TEXT,
  created_at            TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at            TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK (journal_id IS NULL OR journal_id IS source_journal_id),
  CHECK (attribution = 'instructor_transcribed' OR instructor_name = ''),
  CHECK ((source_field = 'none') = (source_text_sha256 IS NULL)),
  CHECK (action_id IS NULL OR action_id IS linked_action_id),
  CHECK ((linked_action_id IS NULL) = (linked_action_title IS NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE skill_self_assessments (
  id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  skill_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skill_catalog_entries(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  kind        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('status', 'confidence')),
  status      TEXT CHECK (status IS NULL OR status IN ('learning', 'practicing', 'needs_review')),
  confidence  INTEGER CHECK (confidence IS NULL OR (TYPEOF(confidence) = 'integer' AND confidence BETWEEN 1 AND 5)),
  sequence    INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (TYPEOF(sequence) = 'integer' AND sequence >= 1),
  operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  set_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK (kind = 'status' OR status IS NULL),
  CHECK (kind = 'confidence' OR confidence IS NULL),
  UNIQUE (skill_id, kind, sequence)
)

CREATE TABLE split_operation_log (
  operation_id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  source_material_id     TEXT REFERENCES study_materials(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  receipt_canonical_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  receipt_hash           TEXT NOT NULL,
  status                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'committed', 'cancelled')),
  created_at             TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at             TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE study_materials (
  id                 TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  title              TEXT NOT NULL,
  material_type      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'study_guide',
  topic              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general',
  review_status      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'needs_review',
  priority           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'later',
  goal_id            TEXT REFERENCES goals(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  event_id           TEXT REFERENCES schedule_events(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  notes              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  file_path          TEXT,
  original_file_name TEXT,
  file_size          INTEGER,
  created_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_reviewed_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE tags (
  id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE transactions (
  id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  type        TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount      INTEGER NOT NULL,
  date        TEXT NOT NULL,
  category    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other',
  description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  notes       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  event_id    TEXT REFERENCES schedule_events(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  goal_id     TEXT REFERENCES goals(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  source      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual',
  created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TRIGGER trg_card_ops_material_delete
AFTER DELETE ON study_materials
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    UPDATE card_review_operations
    SET is_erased = 1, result_json = NULL
    WHERE source_material_id = OLD.id AND is_erased = 0;
END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_cleanup_material_delete
AFTER DELETE ON study_materials
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    UPDATE practice_session_operations
    SET is_erased = 1, result_json = 'null'
    WHERE attempt_id IN (SELECT id FROM practice_attempts
        WHERE source_material_id IS NULL AND status IN ('in_progress', 'abandoned'));

    DELETE FROM practice_attempts
    WHERE source_material_id IS NULL AND status IN ('in_progress', 'abandoned');

    UPDATE practice_test_versions
    SET is_active = 0
    WHERE source_material_id IS NULL AND is_active = 1;

    DELETE FROM practice_test_versions
    WHERE source_material_id IS NULL
      AND id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT version_id FROM practice_attempts WHERE status = 'completed');
END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_enforce_response_item_version_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON practice_responses
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Item does not belong to attempt version')
    WHERE (
        SELECT version_id FROM practice_attempts WHERE id = NEW.attempt_id
    ) != (
        SELECT version_id FROM practice_test_items WHERE id = NEW.item_id
    );
END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_enforce_response_item_version_update
BEFORE UPDATE OF item_id, attempt_id ON practice_responses
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Item does not belong to attempt version')
    WHERE (
        SELECT version_id FROM practice_attempts WHERE id = NEW.attempt_id
    ) != (
        SELECT version_id FROM practice_test_items WHERE id = NEW.item_id
    );
END
